### OpenDialog October 2026 – Issue Four


This month’s *OpenDialog* features OpenBiome Foundation’s Program Director[Michael Bougas](https://openbiome.org/people/michael-bougas/) . An eight -year veteran of the Foundation, he supports healthcare partners treating C. Difficile infections (C.diff) and advances the organization’s work in microbiome-based therapeutics. Mike focuses on ensuring partners have access to the tools and materials they need to care for patients, while continuously improving the behind-the-scenes systems that support them.
